GENERAL_NEWS.summary: The European Central Bank held rates steady while flagging rising inflation risks from energy costs, and the euro slipped as markets weighed a possible December rise.

GENERAL_NEWS.title: Top Russian official takes US journalists into besieged Ukrainian city ahead of evacuation
GENERAL_NEWS.summary: Russia's human rights commissioner travelled to Oleshky with US journalists during a US-brokered ceasefire, as demining continued ahead of hoped-for aid and evacuations.

GENERAL_NEWS.title: ECB President Lagarde resigns effective Feb 7
GENERAL_NEWS.summary: Christine Lagarde will step down as European Central Bank president on 7 February 2027, months before her term was due to end, leaving EU leaders to choose a successor.

GENERAL_NEWS.title: South Africa economy estimated to be 4.9% bigger after rebasing
GENERAL_NEWS.summary: South Africa’s statistics agency revised the economy 4.9% larger after rebasing GDP to 2022, with mining, finance and trade showing the biggest gains.

GENERAL_NEWS.title: Monte dei Paschi shareholders reject merging Mediobanca into group
GENERAL_NEWS.summary: Monte dei Paschi shareholders voted down a proposal to fold merchant bank Mediobanca into the group, with 63.65% of votes against the merger.

GENERAL_NEWS.title: Uganda says 27 citizens killed or presumed dead fighting for Russia in Ukraine
GENERAL_NEWS.summary: Uganda's embassy letter says 27 citizens recruited to fight for Russia in Ukraine are dead or unaccounted for, with 11 confirmed dead and 16 missing.

GENERAL_NEWS.title: MSCI warning a 'short-term shock', Indonesia central bank chief says
GENERAL_NEWS.summary: Indonesia's central bank chief called MSCI's possible market downgrade warning a short-term shock, saying reforms should address the index provider's concerns.

GENERAL_NEWS.title: Greek container ship sinks after drone attack off Bulgaria
GENERAL_NEWS.summary: A Greek container ship sank off Bulgaria after a drone attack, its crew rescued, in the latest strike on Black Sea shipping this month, Bulgaria said.

GENERAL_NEWS.title: Taiwan central bank board members flag inflation woes, minutes show
GENERAL_NEWS.summary: Taiwan's central bank minutes show board members debated a rate rise over inflation worries, with most voting to hold the rate at 2% in September.

GENERAL_NEWS.title: North Korea fires projectile toward sea off east coast, South Korea military says
GENERAL_NEWS.summary: South Korea's military says the North fired a projectile toward the sea off its east coast, with Japan reporting it may have been a ballistic missile.

GENERAL_NEWS.title: Hungary to stick with Orban-era nuclear cooperation deal with US
GENERAL_NEWS.summary: Hungary's new government will ask parliament to make its US civilian nuclear cooperation deal legally binding, keeping the agreement signed under its predecessor.

GENERAL_NEWS.title: Chipmaker SK Hynix to return $75 billion to shareholders after record profit
GENERAL_NEWS.summary: SK Hynix plans about $75 billion in shareholder returns this year after a record quarterly profit, citing strong AI-driven demand for memory chips.

GENERAL_NEWS.title: UK will reduce 'unsustainable' welfare costs, Healey says
GENERAL_NEWS.summary: Chancellor John Healey said Britain's welfare bill must come down, calling the current system unsustainable while stopping short of a firm pre-election pledge.

GENERAL_NEWS.title: European shares inch up ahead of ECB as earnings remain in focus
GENERAL_NEWS.summary: European shares edged higher before the ECB decision, with Shell's strong results lifting energy stocks while Alphabet's earnings weighed on tech.

GENERAL_NEWS.title: Nasdaq futures slide as mixed Big Tech results test AI trade
GENERAL_NEWS.summary: US Nasdaq futures fell as Alphabet slid in premarket trading on heavy AI spending, while Microsoft rose on stronger cloud results.

GENERAL_NEWS.title: Pound steady after Healey's 'continuity budget'
GENERAL_NEWS.summary: Sterling held steady after the UK budget, which raised taxes on banks and landlords while leaving the broader fiscal outlook largely unchanged.

GENERAL_NEWS.title: Japan bonds steady ahead of BOJ decision; strong auction lends support
GENERAL_NEWS.summary: Japanese government bonds held steady before the Bank of Japan decision, helped by strong demand at a two-year note auction.

GENERAL_NEWS.title: ECB to hold rates as investors focus on French bonds, Lagarde's future
GENERAL_NEWS.summary: The ECB is widely expected to hold rates at 2.5% on Thursday, with attention on French bond turmoil and questions over President Lagarde's future.

GENERAL_NEWS.title: South African rand weakens ahead of producer inflation data
GENERAL_NEWS.summary: The rand slipped about 0.4% in early trade as weaker gold and platinum prices weighed, with producer inflation data due later in the day.
